atomic_clause_extraction.clause_text_exact: Trigger an alert if that tracked person hands any object to another person and then the two separate by more than 5 meters within 10 seconds, unless the receiving person is clearly an employee wearing a visible name badge.

Time/threshold rule: Only escalate to High if ≥3 handoff events occur within 15 minutes; otherwise keep severity Low.
Zone rule (map ambiguity): Treat danger zone as the area within 2m of the emergency exit sign; if the camera cannot see the sign clearly, mark zone status as UNKNOWN (do not guess).
 Occlusion rule: If the red jacket color is uncertain due to lighting/occlusion for >5 consecutive frames, set jacket_color = UNKNOWN and pause tracking until reacquired. 
Exclusion with exception: Ignore visitors wearing red jackets unless they cross a taped boundary line marked STAFF ONLY. 
Non-visual dependency: If the person’s badge QR code is not readable, do not assume employee status; employee verification requires an external access-control lookup.
1) Always monitor in the night 2) Monitor in the danger zone
